final: SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(il.UnitPrice) - (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM InvoiceLine) AS deviation_from_overall_average, (AVG(il.UnitPrice) - (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM InvoiceLine)) - (SELECT AVG(invoice_deviation) FROM (SELECT i2.InvoiceId, AVG(il2.UnitPrice) - (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM InvoiceLine) AS invoice_deviation FROM Invoice i2 JOIN InvoiceLine il2 ON il2.InvoiceId = i2.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c2 ON c2.CustomerId = i2.CustomerId WHERE c2.Country = c.Country GROUP BY i2.InvoiceId)) AS deviation_minus_country_average_deviation FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average_deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
